app.title: Trend Pilot AI
design.title: Trend Pilot AI UI kit
design.lead: Trend Pilot AI palette, type and components for approval before screens are built.
section.palette.lead: Colour always carries meaning. Values and statuses are repeated in words or shape.
section.type.lead: Golos Text with tabular figures: digits line up by place value.
type.heading: Categories with 3x margin and above
type.body: Every figure opens up to its formula, source and date.
type.caption: Price as of 18.10.2026 · Kaspi
section.spacing.lead: 4px step. Tight inside a group, generous between groups.
field.price.error: Enter a number greater than zero
table.caption: Category products, demo data
trend.label: Price trend over 7 days, demo
coverage.label: Data from {covered} of {total} marketplaces
card.waterfall: Unit economics: from sale price to net profit
card.why.text: Profit = sale price − landed cost − selling costs. The sale price is an estimated range of {low}–{high}, so profit is shown as three scenarios. All inputs are synthetic, source synthetic:ui-kit, date 18.10.2026. Tax is off by default.
source.reason.pending: No Seller API token. Connects after the seller account is registered.
empty.title: No products match these filters
empty.text: Lower the target multiple or add sourcing marketplaces.
nodata.title: Value without data
nodata.reason: The analytics provider returned no sales
palette.greys: The three greys differ by shape: below 2x shows a number, no data has a dashed underline, an offline source has an icon.
legend.title: How to read the numbers
legend.landed: Landed cost: unit cost delivered to the warehouse (purchase, delivery, duties, packaging, agent).
legend.estimated: ≈ before a number: some inputs are estimates, the realistic scenario is shown.
legend.nodata: “no data”: the source returned no value, no number is substituted.
legend.scenarios: Scenarios use the bounds of input ranges: worst costs and price give the pessimistic one.
legend.loss: Profit in red with an icon: loss per unit.
login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Access is granted by an administrator's invitation.
invite.title: Set your password
invite.lead: Invitation for {email}. The link works once.
invite.error.failed: Could not accept the invitation. Ask the administrator for a new link.
invite.invalid.title: The link is not valid
invite.invalid.text: The link was already used or has expired. Ask the administrator for a new one.
wizard.title: Product search
wizard.lead: Choose where you sell and source, the budget and the target multiple. Marketplaces without a connected source are shown in grey with the reason.
metric.priceToCost.hint: Sale price divided by landed cost. 3x: the price is three times the delivered cost.
metric.roi.hint: Net profit divided by the investment per unit. 3x: profit is three times the investment.
results.title: Categories
results.insufficient.lead: These products are not in the results: the calculation needs a purchase price, a sale price and a demand signal. No estimates are substituted for missing values.
results.noSources.title: No marketplaces available
results.noSources.text: None of the selected marketplaces has a connected source. Choose others or wait for the connection.
category.notMatching: {n} more have data but are below the target multiple or over budget.
editor.title: Calculation inputs
editor.lead: Change any input and the result recalculates at once. Your input is recorded as the source “Your input”.
formula.landed: Landed cost = purchase × rate + China delivery + international shipping + duty + VAT + certification + packaging + agent
formula.selling: Selling costs = fee + logistics + acquiring + advertising + returns + tax
formula.netProfit: Net profit = sale price − landed cost − selling costs
admin.title: Admin
admin.orgs.title: Organizations
admin.orgs.name: Name
admin.orgs.empty.title: No organizations yet
admin.orgs.empty.text: Create a client organization, then invite a user.
admin.invite.title: Invite a user
admin.invite.lead: The user gets a one-time link and sets their own password. The link is valid for 72 hours.
admin.invite.once: Copy it now: the link is shown once and is not stored in the database.
admin.sources.title: Source registry
admin.sources.lead: The status decides whether a source takes part in “All” mode. Inactive marketplaces are shown to users in grey with the reason.
admin.references.title: Reference data
admin.references.lead: Only values from official sources, with a link and retrieval date. Demo data never goes here.
admin.references.empty.title: This reference is empty
admin.references.empty.text: Add a value from an official source. While the reference is empty, the calculation shows “no data” for this field.
ref.error.number: Invalid number; a share is between 0 and 1
ref.error.db: The database rejected the value: check the fields
range.flat: No range: the inputs have no spread estimates, so all three scenarios are equal.
category.legend: ≈ marks a formula estimate. The formula, source and date of each value are in the product card under “Why this number?”.
admin.sources.error.reason: Give a reason for “blocked” and “disabled”: users will see it
